description.narrative: The objective of the Immunization Plus and Malaria Progress by Accelerating Coverage and Transforming Services Project for Nigeria is to reduce under-five mortality rate in program areas. The Project has four components. 1. Malaria Control component will focus on: (a) Strengthening Service Delivery and (b) Health Systems Strengthening and Technical Assistance. 2. Immunization Plus component will additionally focus on (c) Vaccines, Cold Chain and Logistics. 3. Knowledge for Change component will entail: (a) Strengthening Monitoring and Evaluation Systems; (b) Integrating Social Behavior Change Communications and (c) Learning Agenda. 4. Contingent Emergency Response Component (CERC) will serve as a first-line financing option for emergency response.
The project development objective (PDO) of the first phase (IMPACT) is to improve the utilization and quality of immunization plus and malaria services in selected states.

condition.narrative: The Recipient shall ensure, throughout the implementation of the Project, that the proportion of the Recipient's funds appropriatedfor vaccines sourced from domestic resources is no less than the target percentages acceptable to the Association, as discussedduring annual reviews to be conducted no later than December 31 of each calendar year.

The Recipient shall establish, within one (1) month after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain at all times during Projectimplementation, a National Steering Committee (NSC) chaired by the Honorable Minister of Health; and shall cause each ParticipatingState to establish and maintain at all times during Project implementation in such State, a State Steering Committee (SSC) chairedby the State Commissioner of Health; both with a mandate, composition, staffing and resources acceptable to the Association, and asfurther elaborated in the Project Implementation Manual (PIM).

The Recipient shall furnish to the Association, as soon as available, but in any case not later than November 30 of each year, theannual work plans and budgets and the evidence of the approvals referred to in paragraph 1 of Schedule 2, Section I.D of theFinancing Agreement, for their review and approval; except for the annual work plan and budget for the Project for the first yearof Project implementation, which shall be furnished no later than one (1) month after the Effective Date. Only the activitiesincluded in an annual work plan and budget expressly approved by the Association (each an “Annual Work Plan and Budget”) areeligible to a financing from the proceeds of the Financing.

The Recipient shall recruit on a competitive basis, an independent external auditor, with qualifications, experience and terms ofreference acceptable to the Association, to carry out audits for the Project as required in the General Conditions and the DFIL.
